reason: I'd download it and try the free basil pork, but I don't pay monthly for recipes when I already learn dishes free from the clips I watch every night before bed. 99 baht is two plates of kaprao from the stall downstairs.
objection: It's one more monthly charge. The free month is how they catch you: I'd forget to cancel and keep paying for an app I open twice a month in my tiny one-pan kitchen.
would_change_my_mind: Let me pay once, around 149 baht, to keep the dishes for good, with no monthly charge.
